nonqualifying_classes.derived_condition: unblocking interval occurs without an independently eligible method
nonqualifying_classes.policy: Component cleaning or unblocking bounds alone are not a carrier investigation.

nonqualifying_classes.derived_condition: the complete value is only a susceptibility code
nonqualifying_classes.policy: A bare susceptibility code lacks a carrier-oriented temperature or diagnostic experiment.

nonqualifying_classes.derived_condition: the complete value is only the ambiguous AN code
nonqualifying_classes.policy: AN is not expanded to anisotropy unless the source states AMS, AIR, AAR, or magnetic fabric.

nonqualifying_classes.derived_condition: only the two ambiguous bare codes occur
nonqualifying_classes.policy: Two weak database codes do not establish a performed carrier experiment in original text.

nonqualifying_classes.derived_condition: one or more carrier concepts occur without an eligible method
nonqualifying_classes.policy: A mineral name is a retrieval cue, not standalone proof of a target-bound investigation.

nonqualifying_classes.derived_condition: a nonempty value matches no curated semantic concept
nonqualifying_classes.policy: Unclassified historical text is retained only as an aggregate coverage count.

runtime_policy.method_only_use: positive-associated retrieval cue requiring target-bound performed context
runtime_policy.strong_chain_use: method plus diagnostic or carrier is a high-specificity retrieval template
runtime_policy.weak_class_use: retrieval or review cue only; never standalone positive proof

split.algorithm: SHA256(salt + NUL + canonical paper identity), first 8 bytes as unsigned big-endian divided by 2^64
